step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Telecoming's automated web testing platform (Aquarius). 1. An EC2 instance acts as an orchestrator connected to an RDS database to fetch test configurations. 2. RDS supplies configuration details to tasks running in ECS with Fargate Spot. 3. Fargate containers execute test suites and output execution logs into an S3 bucket. 4. An internal Intranet web interface reads test reports from S3 to monitor platform quality. Enterprise Support is depicted as an advisory entity.

graph.name: Telecoming Aquarius Automated Web Testing Architecture
graph.notes: Aquarius orchestrates automated web performance testing at scale using Fargate Spot and S3 storage.
